envelope.summary: AntigravityEmitter and AssetBundle adhere strictly to cisternal emitter protocol, deterministic immutability, and official Antigravity plugin customization specification.
cisternal assets install dual-surface support, scope resolution, validation error exits, dry-run UX, and pyproject.toml 0.1.1a5 configuration are robust and compliant.
Test suites in test_export_antigravity.py and test_install_antigravity.py provide high-quality verification across all emitter rules, subagents synthesis, and CLI scope resolution.
